questions.question: Japan's space agency JAXA launched a mission aiming to collect surface samples from which Martian moon?
questions.explanation: The Martian Moons eXploration probe took off aboard an H3 rocket with plans to gather material from Phobos and return it to Earth.
questions.context: Japanese space program: JAXA launches the Martian Moons eXploration spacecraft from the Tanegashima Space Center toward Phobos aboard an H3 rocket, aiming to collect at least 10 grams of surface material from the Martian moon and return the samples to Earth in 2031.

questions.question: South Korea recalled additional diplomatic staff from which country following an argument concerning captured North Korean troops?
questions.explanation: Diplomatic personnel were pulled out of Ukraine by South Korea amid a disagreement over two captured North Korean soldiers.
questions.context: South Korea–Ukraine relations: South Korea withdraws additional embassy staff from Ukraine following a dispute over two captured North Korean soldiers who were transferred to South Korea.

questions.story: Sudanese civil war > Blue Nile campaign
questions.question: The armed forces of which country claimed to have repelled a joint assault in Blue Nile state?
questions.explanation: The Sudanese Army stated that its troops successfully beat back an offensive launched by rival forces in Blue Nile state.
questions.context: Sudanese civil war > Blue Nile campaign: The Sudanese Army says that they have repelled an attack by the Rapid Support Forces and Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North (SPLM–N) on the Blue Nile state.

questions.question: Which African nation confirmed its first case of the Ebola virus during the current epidemic?
questions.explanation: Nigeria has officially confirmed its first recorded infection during the ongoing outbreak of Ebola.
questions.context: 2026 Ebola epidemic: Nigeria announces its first case of Ebola virus in the epidemic.

questions.question: A federal judge in the United States handed down a 30-year sentence to a smuggler from which country over a deadly 2022 incident in Texas?
questions.explanation: A citizen of Guatemala received a 30-year prison sentence in the US for his role in organising the fatal human trafficking run.
questions.context: 2022 San Antonio migrant deaths: A United States federal judge sentences a Guatemalan national to 30 years in prison for helping organize a 2022 migrant-smuggling operation in San Antonio, Texas, that left 53 migrants dead and 11 injured.
